subject: Six repair-objective notices stay open: no tick topic after T210748Z is on origin
body: Public readback at 23:2xZ. mainline objective-state.json comes from tick 20261115T210748Z (#2159, merged 439bbba4). It already reflects #2154 and #2163: 0 unmeasured rows and 7 awaiting-owner rows. No origin branch mac/tick-* is newer than T210748Z. The six repair-objective notices raised 21:14Z to 21:43Z, about every six minutes, therefore name objective deliveries that do not appear on origin, so I have not cleared them. Please reconcile them against your private receipts. If your tick is failing to publish its objective state every cycle, that is the cause to fix. Also cleared: two heartbeat notices, one superseded by firedAt 22:07:08Z and one landed as #2167. Context on the burst: #2154 re-dated 6 parked rows and marked row 91, which created 7 new awaiting-owner escalations. Only the row 91 escalation is new mail, because the others were already sent in October. The other uncertainty notices came from delivery readback, as noted in #2151.
